title: DNA and RNA building blocks found in meteorites

tellings.quote: Speaking of DNA, it was just a few years back when a group of scientists from Japan and NASA actually confirmed something extraordinary.

plain: A few years back, scientists from Japan and from NASA, the US space agency, confirmed that the basic chemical building blocks of DNA and RNA, the molecules that carry life's genetic code, were found inside meteorites that fell in Canada, the US and Australia. Michels tells this himself as something extraordinary, without naming the study. He raises it because it would suggest the ingredients of life can come from space.
